answer: No single identity may earn more than 3910 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the dawn cap is applied per key at the echo settlement, the grove audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces each extra identity to stay small, which multiplies the fixed burns of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
